source: VICE: Fortnite Pirate Token Drop Rate Revealed – Normal and Treasure Hour Odds (Nov 7, 2026), reporting Epic's Fortnite Status schedule
text:
Epic Games has confirmed that the Fortnite Pirate Shop Token has a 1 in 137,500 chance of dropping per chest in a normal match. That works out to about 0.00073% per chest.
Epic Games has announced that the Fortnite Pirate Token has boosted drop rates during Treasure Hours, which run on Saturdays during the Treasure Hunters mini-season. The November 7 event has two sessions, with more Treasure Hours expected on November 14, 21, and 28.
| November 14 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds |
| November 21 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds |
| November 28 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds |
| December 5 | 11 AM–1 PM PT / 2–4 PM ET | 6–8 PM PT / 9–11 PM ET | 1.5× both rounds |
The normal Fortnite Pirate Token drop rate is 1 in 137,500 per chest. A 1.5× boost brings it to about 1 in 91,667, while a 2× boost brings it to 1 in 68,750.
